The number 256 raised to the power of 2.25 can be expressed as a mixed number and then converted to an improper fraction. By rewriting the expression, it can be simplified to (256^(1/4))^9. The fourth root of 256 is 4, resulting in (4)^9. Calculating this yields 4^9, which equals 262,144. Therefore, 256^2.25 equals 262,144.
